prompt: We enabled scalar quantization on our collection but RAM usage didn't decrease at all. Looking at the node-level metrics, there's still a bunch of cache memory. What went wrong?

assertions.text: Explains quantization reduces forced-resident memory, NOT OS page cache
Describes cache as expected and healthy, not a problem to eliminate
Recommends checking metrics endpoint to confirm data usage actually dropped
Notes that vectors are memory-mapped by default, so on_disk=True may be redundant
Mentions full-text indexes as a possible hidden RAM consumer
Warns against setting always_ram=False (causes performance collapse)
